newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Pharmacia Biotech says raises stake in Korea JV.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia Biotech says raises stake in Korea JV.

text.p: Swedish biotechnology group Pharmacia Biotech said on Tuesday it increased its stake in its South Korean joint venture company Pharmacia Biotech Korea Ltd. to 90 percent from 49 percent.
The purchase agreement also gives Pharmacia Biotech the right to acquire the remaining 10 percent of shares from the local partner Dong-Il Corp. in two years, the company said in a statement.

"In order to capitalise on the rapid market growth in South Korea in the best possible way we want full control over our operations in the country, and we have therefore decided to acquire the joint venture company," company spokesman Per-Erik Sandlund said.
Pharmacia Biotech will set up its own office in Seoul and increase the number of employees in the country, it said.
The company has been investing in developing operations in Southeast Asia for a number of years, it said.
